description: This file contains unit tests for the OAuthKey functionality within the SuiteCRM project, specifically testing the OAuthKey class and related methods like getByKey, fetchKey, and mark_deleted.

classes.name: OAuthKeyTest
classes.description: Unit test class for OAuthKey operations in SuiteCRM, extending the base PHPUnit framework test case.

methods.name: setUp
methods.description: Sets up the test environment, initializing global variables and default configurations.

methods.name: testOAuthKey
methods.description: Tests the creation and initial properties of the OAuthKeys bean and verifies its class hierarchy.

methods.name: testMain
methods.description: Tests the full flow of creating, saving, and then retrieving/deleting an OAuthKey record.

methods.name: getByKey
methods.description: Tests the getByKey method for both invalid and valid keys, verifying correct retrieval.

methods.name: fetchKey
methods.description: Tests the static fetchKey method for invalid and valid keys, verifying correct behavior.

methods.name: mark_deleted
methods.description: Marks an OAuthKey record as deleted and verifies deletion by attempting to retrieve it afterwards.
